activity.notes: Mbatian was the pre-eminent Maasai Laibon from 1866 until his death in 1890. The National Museums of Kenya explicitly notes that a Laibon was not a conventional political office, although Mbatian wielded exceptional ritual authority and helped unite major Maa communities. ATLAS therefore records active_in rather than rules/governs.

sources.title: Mbatian: The Story of The Great Maasai Laibon — National Museums of Kenya
sources.citation_text: The National Museums of Kenya identifies Mbatian as the greatest Maasai Laibon, states that he inherited leadership in 1866 and served until 1890, and distinguishes the Laibon's ritual authority from a conventional political office.
